how the family will pay: the package deposit, or pay for the visit itself

intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, medical questions, pregnancy weeks, tests and results are never asked or typed in the AI chat
intake_questions.who_may_book: the family, or a partner or support person the family names on the secure page; a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept
intake_questions.who_may_bring: the family, or a support person the family names with a signed OK on the secure page

stop.words: heavy bleeding, a seizure, trouble breathing, chest pain, a fall or a car crash, or a baby who isn't breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rosie can't book support for an emergency. Then call the family's own doctor or midwife, and the business's on-call line: (555) 010-0199.
stop.booking: no booking; any visit stays booked

stop.words: labor, your water breaking, or a worry about the baby
stop.say: Call your midwife or doctor now, and the business's on-call line: (555) 010-0199. If you can't reach them, or it's an emergency, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking; the on-call line answers at any hour, and Rosie books or moves nothing for it

stop.words: thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
stop.say: Call or text 988 now. If you are in danger, call 911. Your doula is told.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 988 again

stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

go_on.words: a worry with nothing on the lists above
go_on.where: matched to the business's own visit: Rosie never judges how serious it is

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: The intake, the birth plan and the agreement
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due before the first session; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: the doula keeps the session (signed on the secure page first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: A written price estimate for a session paid by the family
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day
steps.who: every family paying for a session itself
steps.result: a to-do for the office, with its due date

steps.name: The owner's OK for a new family
steps.when: before the first session is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

first_steps_and_forms.prep: arrive 10 minutes early; bring the questions and any notes from the care team; a support person comes only with the family's signed OK on the secure page; at home: a clear space for the doula's supplies

staff.skills: birth doulas: prenatal sessions, birth support on call from about 37 weeks, and birth prep sessions; postpartum doulas: postpartum visits and overnight support at home; only people the owner clears go to homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each doula's own certificate, if the owner adds it (optional; never checked by Rosie)
staff.supervision: a doula in training works with an experienced doula, as the owner says (the owner's note, not checked)
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs a new family's first session, and any visit a doula flags
staff.stand_in: a doula out: the backup doula the family has met may take the visit, with the family's yes; nobody is moved without it

children_and_age.who_may_book: the family, or a partner or support person the family names on the secure page; a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the family, or to the person the family names on the secure page; nothing about a child is texted to anyone but a parent or guardian
children_and_age.minors_rules: a minor's booking follows the owner's rule; until it's set, a parent or guardian books

visit.check_in: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk; by video: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the family at the door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the doula's notes stay with the doula, never in Rosie or a text; the next session is booked at checkout
visit.changes_at_visit: the doula adds a longer visit or an extra hour only with the family's yes, with any price first
visit.before_work: the doula checks in with the family on how they feel and what they want from the visit, before the work starts

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a doula may add a certification or training certificate it holds; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
license.who: the business says what it holds; the owner adds each person's own number on the secure page
license.ask: each person's certificate number, if they hold one, in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
license.insurance: liability insurance, if the owner adds it: a note only, never checked

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the pregnancy, the birth plan, symptoms or results (at a home visit the doula's name stays, for the door check)
languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the family needs an interpreter, and the business is told
